safety.title: Safety Tips
safety.t1: Always store cylinders upright in a ventilated area.
safety.t2: Check hoses and regulators for leaks with soapy water.
safety.t3: Turn off the valve when not in use, especially overnight.

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.q1: Which quarters in Buea do you deliver to?
faq.a1: We currently deliver across Buea: Molyko, Great Soppo, Small Soppo, Bonduma, Bomaka, Bokwango, Muea, Mile 16, Check Point, Long Street, Buea Town, Government Residential Area (GRA), Clerks Quarter, Federal Quarters and Bokwai. More quarters coming soon.
faq.a2: Cash on Delivery, MTN Mobile Money and Orange Money.
faq.q3: Can I exchange an empty cylinder?
faq.a3: Yes — hand over your empty cylinder to the rider when your refill arrives.
